claim: When an io-free core is held by ESLint no-restricted-properties/globals, also restrict globalThis and bare builtin module names, and keep one ESLint.lintText canary per shape in the test runner, because property and import restrictions are bypassed by globalThis.Math.random() and import from "fs" while every test stays green.
because: Probed a TypeScript game core: the wall fired on 9 of 22 planted shapes; after extending it and adding canaries, removing any one restriction fails its canary.
